import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, matplotlib.patches as mpatches, numpy as np

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13.2,6.6)); ax.axis("off")
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,7.4)

present="#2f6f9f"; absent="#9f3f3f"; cand="#c47a1a"; neutral="#8f8f8f"
def box(x,y,w,h,txt,col,fc="white",fs=8.6,lw=1.6,ls="-"):
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch((x,y),w,h,boxstyle="round,pad=0.06",
                 edgecolor=col,facecolor=fc,linewidth=lw,linestyle=ls))
    ax.text(x+w/2,y+h/2,txt,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=fs)
def arrow(x1,y1,x2,y2,col="0.3",ls="-",lab=None,labdx=0,labdy=0.18,fs=7.8):
    ax.annotate("",xy=(x2,y2),xytext=(x1,y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>",color=col,linewidth=1.5,linestyle=ls))
    if lab: ax.text((x1+x2)/2+labdx,(y1+y2)/2+labdy,lab,ha="center",fontsize=fs,color=col)

ax.text(0.1,7.1,"Reconstruction of the fate of the PcrB product from the G. kaustophilus HTA426 genome",
        fontsize=12.5,fontweight="bold")
ax.text(0.1,6.72,"blue = ortholog present (locus tag given)   red = no candidate in this genome   orange = candidate only, no gene assigned in any organism",
        fontsize=8.4,color="0.35")

# substrates
box(0.2,5.5,2.25,0.75,"all-trans-heptaprenyl-PP\nHepS GK2212 / HepT GK2210",present,"#eaf1f7")
box(0.2,4.25,2.25,0.75,"sn-glycerol-1-phosphate\nno G1P dehydrogenase\n(AraM/EgsA absent)",absent,"#f7ecec",fs=8.2)
box(3.25,4.9,1.9,0.95,"PcrB  GK0274\nQ5L3C1\nPDB 4NAE + 1GP",present,"#dce9f3",fs=8.8,lw=2.2)
arrow(2.45,5.85,3.25,5.55); arrow(2.45,4.65,3.25,5.1)

box(5.95,4.9,1.85,0.95,"HepGP\n3-heptaprenyl-\nsn-glycero-1-P",neutral,"#f2f2f2",fs=8.6)
arrow(5.15,5.37,5.95,5.37)

# branch down: Bacillales route
box(5.95,3.35,1.85,0.8,"HepG\nphosphatase step\nunassigned",cand,"#f9f1e4",fs=8.3)
arrow(6.87,4.9,6.87,4.15,col=cand,lab="dephosphorylation",labdx=-1.35,labdy=0.0)
ax.text(8.0,3.72,"candidate GK3079 (PpaX, HAD)\nco-operonic with GK3078",fontsize=7.8,color=cand,va="center")

box(5.95,1.95,1.85,0.8,"Ac-HepG\nYvoF  GK3078",present,"#dce9f3",fs=8.6)
arrow(6.87,3.35,6.87,2.75,col=present,lab="acetyl-CoA",labdx=-0.75,labdy=0)

box(5.95,0.55,1.85,0.8,"N-acetyl-lipoprotein\nLhaT  GK2189",present,"#dce9f3",fs=8.6)
arrow(6.87,1.95,6.87,1.35,col=present)
ax.text(8.0,0.95,"Lgt GK3081, LspA GK1145\npresent (lipoprotein maturation)",fontsize=7.8,color=present,va="center")
ax.text(8.0,2.35,"PMID 40626731:\nAc-HepG required for\nlipoprotein acetylation",fontsize=7.8,color="0.3",va="center")

# branch right: archaeal route, all absent
for i,(lbl,y) in enumerate([("DGGGP synthase\n(2nd prenylation)",4.0),("CarS\nCDP-archaeol synthase",2.75),("geranylgeranyl reductase\n(chain saturation)",1.5)]):
    box(2.55,y-0.35,2.3,0.72,lbl+"\nABSENT",absent,"#f7ecec",fs=7.9,ls="--",lw=1.3)
arrow(5.95,5.1,4.85,4.25,col=absent,ls="--")
ax.annotate("", xy=(4.0,4.4), xytext=(4.0,3.1), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>",color=absent,linewidth=1.2,linestyle="--"))
ax.annotate("", xy=(4.0,3.15), xytext=(4.0,1.85), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>",color=absent,linewidth=1.2,linestyle="--"))
ax.text(2.55,0.85,"archaeal diether membrane-lipid route:\nno candidate for any of the three steps\n(best scores 29, 31, 53 bits vs 255-283 for true orthologs)",
        fontsize=7.9,color=absent)
ax.text(0.1,0.12,"Scores: ungapped BLOSUM62 HSP search of each query against all 3516 HTA426 proteins (UP000001172). Gene order from KEGG. Structure from RCSB.",
        fontsize=7.4,color="0.45")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
